items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder: a static grid under a soft shimmer band that translates linearly left to right (1.6 s loop). role=presentation by default; SkeletonGroup is the single status. Reduced: the band pulses in opacity; off: still.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The grid scan is a CSS gradient and a Web Animation; no original assets are used. v4: the shimmer is a linear translateX band over a static grid (was a stepped down-scan).
